verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a dedicated Payment Initiation product, the European Payments suite. It lets users make real-time payments from their bank without entering account details, and its geography is stated explicitly as 18 European markets. Community notes that Plaid relies on PSD2/Open Banking in Europe are consistent with this. Auth only supplies account and routing numbers for the developer to run ACH themselves, so it is a building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: the specific list of live countries, API-level detail of the payment flow and status tracking, any US pay-by-bank initiation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
